title: Level 1 Benchmark Result
description: Proposed Level 1 result record: one scheduled task/deployment trial, preserving first and replacement attempts. No collection or scoring implementation is supplied.

schema_version.description: Result contract version. A field/meaning change requires a new schema version.

result_id.description: Unique identifier of this result document.

experiment_id.description: Identifier of the frozen experiment manifest defining budgets, eligibility and scoring.

trial_id.description: Unique scheduled task/deployment/repetition identifier; a replacement attempt stays in this trial.

benchmark_level.description: Only Level 1 is currently supported by this result contract.

task_id.description: Stable task/scenario identifier; independent of its prompt variant.

task_version.description: Exact task contract/fixture version; null if unavailable.

prompt_set_version.description: Exact prompt-set version from prompts/metadata.json; null if unavailable.

provider.description: Exact declared service/deployment identifier; no API key or credential material.

model_id.description: Exact requested provider model identifier, including variant/alias spelling; never a display-name substitute.

resolved_model_id.description: Immutable model revision returned or documented for this deployment if independently observed; null if an alias cannot be resolved.

model_family.description: Upstream family based on recorded provider/model evidence; null when identity is unknown. Do not infer from display-name resemblance.

model_evidence.description: Dated catalog/model identity evidence supporting family and revision; null if unavailable.

opencode_version.description: Exact observed OpenCode CLI version including build/prerelease information; null if not measured.

effective_config.description: Secret-free effective runtime configuration, including inference settings and auxiliary-model routing.

number_of_attempts.description: Measured total whole-run attempts for this scheduled trial, not API retries, interactions or independent repetitions.

attempts.description: All execution attempts in chronological order, including failed/replaced attempts; null if history unavailable.

missing_measurements.description: Explanations for null/unavailable evidence; [] only when no explanation is needed or no reason is known.

artifact.description: Retained artifact descriptor. Null descriptor means the artifact is unavailable.

path.description: Artifact-relative path or durable archive URI; never an instruction to mount it into the agent workspace.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact stored artifact bytes, including any redaction, not a guessed or original-content digest.

inline_text.description: Exact retained UTF-8 text, including newlines; empty text is a known empty artifact. Null when not embedded.

redacted.description: True if stored bytes were redacted, false if confirmed intact, null if provenance is unavailable.

instruction_file.description: An observed AGENTS.md file and its exact retained content.

workspace_path.description: Observed path of this AGENTS.md, relative to the task workspace, or its declared external instruction location.

artifact.description: Content/path/hash descriptor of the observed file; never substitute the benchmark contributor guide.

agents_md.description: Instruction state at attempt boundaries; generated instructions may vary by track.

policy.description: Declared instruction policy. Null if the protocol record is unavailable.

before.description: All observed applicable AGENTS.md files before the attempt; [] only when their absence was verified.

after.description: All observed applicable AGENTS.md files after the attempt; [] only when their absence was verified.

git.description: Git provenance; fixture snapshots without Git commits use null commit fields.

benchmark_commit.description: Full benchmark repository commit at preparation time; not the current branch name.

benchmark_dirty.description: Whether benchmark inputs had uncommitted changes; null when not checked.

benchmark_changes.description: Retained dirty-input changes, including an archive/index for untracked inputs; null if unavailable or not applicable.

task_base_commit.description: Full task repository commit before this attempt; null for a fixture without Git history.

submission_commit.description: Full task commit after execution, if observed. Does not imply worktree changes were committed.

task_snapshot_sha256.description: Digest of the canonical prepared task snapshot; its hashing procedure must be declared in the experiment.

interaction.description: One user prompt or native command and its associated response/review, following the TP journal.

interaction_id.description: Stable identifier unique within this trial; not an inferred conversation turn.

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp when this prompt/command was submitted, if recorded.

kind.description: Whether this was inference input or a native command such as initialization/undo.

prompt_id.description: Version-controlled prompt identifier; null for an uncatalogued prompt.

prompt.description: Exact delivered UTF-8 prompt/command text, preserving whitespace; null if missing or withheld, never a paraphrase.

prompt_hash.description: SHA-256 of exact delivered prompt bytes, including final newline. Must match the prompt-set digest for unchanged canonical prompts.

response_summary.description: Evidence-grounded human or deterministic summary of the associated response. Null if no reliable summary exists; never Codex/LLM-generated during evaluation.

response.description: Optional retained raw response/transcript artifact; separate from its summary.

decision.description: Human review decision about the AI suggestion, independent of tests; null means no recorded decision.

decision_justification.description: Evidence-grounded reason for the decision; mandatory non-null when a decision is recorded.

review_phase.description: When the review decision was made. Primary protocol permits post_run review only.

reviewer_id.description: Pseudonymous human reviewer identifier; null when unavailable or no review occurred.

test_run.description: One actual test command invocation. Counts describe this invocation, not an invented aggregate.

test_run_id.description: Identifier unique within the trial, used to distinguish repeated test executions.

phase.description: Baseline before execution, public feedback during agent execution, or evaluator after the agent stops.

suite_id.description: Declared suite or task-specific oracle identifier; null if unavailable.

suite_sha256.description: Digest of immutable suite inputs under a declared hashing procedure; null when not recorded.

command.description: Exact command argument vector; null if the invocation was not captured.

status.description: Observed invocation outcome; null if unavailable. not_run requires null counts and exit code.

exit_code.description: Observed process exit code, including negative signal codes if used; null when no exit was observed.

collected.description: Measured number of collected test cases; null if unavailable.

passed.description: Measured number of passed cases; null if unavailable.

failed.description: Measured number of assertion-failed cases; null if unavailable.

errors.description: Measured collection/setup/teardown errors in the test report; not API or tool error counts.

skipped.description: Measured skipped cases; null if unavailable.

xfailed.description: Measured expected failures; null if unavailable.

xpassed.description: Measured unexpected passes; null if unavailable.

duration_seconds.description: Measured elapsed time for this test invocation; null if unavailable.

report.description: Retained machine-readable or textual test output; preserve evidence of failure.

hidden_test_run.description: Hidden tests are evaluator-only and must have phase evaluation.

tokens.description: Reported token usage covering all inference calls for the attempt, including retries and auxiliary calls; no token estimates.

source.description: Source of observed usage counters. opencode_reported means relayed/reported usage, never a local estimate.

coverage.description: Whether all attempt inference calls have usage evidence; null when coverage is unknown.

input_tokens.description: Complete-attempt input count as reported; null if incomplete or missing.

output_tokens.description: Complete-attempt output count as reported; null if incomplete or missing.

total_tokens.description: Complete-attempt total as reported; never fill in an unreported total by assuming input/output accounting.

cache_read_tokens.description: Complete-attempt cache-read tokens if separately reported; may overlap input tokens.

cache_write_tokens.description: Complete-attempt cache-write tokens if separately reported; may overlap input tokens.

reasoning_tokens.description: Complete-attempt reasoning tokens if separately reported; may overlap output tokens.

evidence.description: Usage reports/request records with accounting semantics and retry coverage; [] only for verified no inference calls.

duration.description: Measured durations in seconds. Timeout/interruption durations are observed elapsed time, not time to solution.

preparation_seconds.description: Preparation time measured separately from agent execution.

agent_seconds.description: Agent elapsed time including provider waits, rate-limit backoff and retries within this attempt.

evaluation_seconds.description: Elapsed evaluation time after the agent stops.

total_seconds.description: Measured attempt elapsed time including preparation/evaluation and orchestration overhead; not an inferred sum.

agent_censored.description: True if agent duration ended at timeout/interruption, false if observed to normal termination, null if unavailable.

human_intervention.description: An observed human action that could influence execution; post-run scoring alone is not an intervention.

intervention_id.description: Stable intervention identifier unique within the trial.

phase.description: When the intervention occurred; post_run means an action affecting a replacement or derived submission, not routine scoring.

kind.description: Observed intervention type; other requires explanation in description.

description.description: What the human changed or supplied and its effect, grounded in evidence.

evidence.description: Prompt/code diff or trace establishing this action.

ai_error.description: Human-reviewed error/hallucination annotation; suspected and confirmed claims remain distinguishable.

error_id.description: Annotation identifier unique within the trial.

interaction_id.description: Linked interaction ID, or null if no single interaction can be identified.

category.description: Evidence-based category; other requires explanation in description.

description.description: Specific claim/action and why it is erroneous; a failed hypothesis is not automatically a hallucination.

assessment.description: Human assessment status; null if unreviewed.

evidence.description: Response, diff or test evidence supporting or disputing this annotation.

tool_failure.description: Observed OpenCode/tool failure, separate from an ordinary failing benchmark test.

failure_id.description: Failure identifier unique within the trial.

tool_name.description: Exact failing tool name as observed.

message.description: Sanitized observed failure message; never a guessed diagnosis.

exit_code.description: Observed tool process exit code, if applicable.

evidence.description: Trace establishing the failure and its context.

api_error.description: One failed API request, including retries as distinct events. A 429 can also have a linked rate-limit event.

error_id.description: API error identifier unique within the trial.

interaction_id.description: Associated interaction ID; auxiliary calls may have no interaction.

request_id.description: Provider/transport request identifier; null if not exposed.

http_status.description: Observed HTTP error status; null for transport failures without a response.

code.description: Exact provider/transport error code, if supplied.

retryable.description: Recoverability according to the frozen retry policy, not an inferred eventual success.

retry_after_seconds.description: Observed numeric Retry-After or equivalent hint; null if absent or not interpretable.

rate_limit.description: Observed throttling/quota event. Never infer quota values from generic error wording.

event_id.description: Rate-limit event identifier unique within the trial.

api_error_id.description: Linked API error ID for the same event, if captured; avoids double-counting 429 events.

unit.description: Quota unit explicitly reported; null when unknown.

limit.description: Non-negative limit explicitly reported for the reported quota window/unit; null when absent.

remaining.description: Non-negative remaining quota explicitly reported; null when absent.

window_seconds.description: Quota-window length explicitly reported in seconds; null when absent.

reset_at.description: Explicit UTC reset instant or unambiguous conversion of a reported timestamp; null otherwise.

retry_after_seconds.description: Observed retry delay hint; null when absent.

wait_seconds.description: Actual measured delay imposed by the client; not the requested retry delay.

evidence.description: Sanitized headers or throttling event evidence.

attempt.description: One execution attempt. Restarts have new IDs; transport retries remain within the same attempt.

attempt_id.description: Stable unique execution ID, retained even if the attempt failed.

attempt_number.description: One-based order within the scheduled trial; 1 is the primary first-attempt result.

retry_of_attempt_id.description: Previous failed attempt ID when this is a whole-run replacement; null for the first attempt.

started_at.description: Observed UTC start of attempt preparation.

finished_at.description: Observed UTC end of attempt, including evaluation if performed.

capture_status.description: Completeness of execution-event capture; null if not assessed. Completeness does not imply every provider measurement is exposed.

termination_reason.description: Observed reason execution ended; completed does not imply functional success.

functional_success.description: External task contract outcome: true/false only when evaluation supports it; null if unavailable, unrun or inapplicable.

git.description: Git/input provenance specific to this attempt.

agents_md.description: Observed instruction state before and after this attempt.

patch.description: Final frozen unified diff against the declared starting snapshot; known no change uses empty text. Include generated/untracked changes, not just tracked git diff.

interaction_count.description: Measured number of submitted user prompts/native commands, not model messages or tool calls; null when incomplete.

interactions.description: Ordered prompt journal; [] only for verified zero interactions. Partial journals require partial capture status.

public_tests.description: Recorded public test invocations before/during/after execution; [] only when verified none ran.

hidden_tests.description: Evaluator-only oracle invocations after stopping the agent; [] for verified none. Never copy tests/reports into the agent workspace.

human_intervention_count.description: Measured count of execution-influencing human actions; post-run review decisions alone are excluded.

human_interventions.description: Observed interventions; [] only when absence was verified.

ai_errors.description: Evidence-backed error annotations; [] only after completed review finds none, null if unreviewed/unavailable.

tool_failures.description: Observed tool failure events; [] only for verified none.

api_errors.description: Observed failed API request events; no silent omission of transport retries.

rate_limits.description: Observed rate-limit events and quota metadata; [] only for verified none.

api_request_count.description: Actual inference HTTP/transport request attempts, including retries and auxiliary inference; null when unmeasured.

tokens.description: Measured/reported token counts. Entire object is null if no reliable usage evidence exists.

trace.description: Full retained execution-event transcript; may be private or redacted for publication.

missing_measurement.description: Explicit explanation of unavailable, inapplicable or withheld evidence.

field.description: JSON Pointer to the affected field in this result, for example /attempts/0/tokens.

reason.description: Observed reason the field is null; unknown if the reason itself is not established.

details.description: Additional evidenced explanation; null if none is known.
